purpose: Extend committed Method A from layer 6 to layers 5 and 9.
reference_protocol: scripts/geometry_of_truth/14_method_a_reconstruction_finetune.py; same GoT-A/OWT replay objective, batches, optimizer, steps, sparsity controller and guards.

evaluation.data: validation only; GoT/RepE test rows never scored
evaluation.paired_comparisons: method_a vs base and method_a vs owt_only
evaluation.uncertainty: mean paired difference + SD + two-sided 95% Student-t CI across the 3 training seeds; CI is descriptive because n=3

success_criteria.primary: For each layer and architecture: Method A geographic B-MLP gap < paired base AND < paired OWT-only on all 3 seeds, and mean paired improvement > 2 x SD of paired improvements.
guards: OWT validation L0 within +/-5% of paired base on every seed
OWT splice delta CE <= 1.10 x paired base on every seed
OWT validation EV >= paired base - 0.005 on every seed
